scope: Current semantic-38 circuit module: compiler information, dynamic work and isolated probes. No runtime optimization adopted without repeatable throughput and full correctness validation.

build_pipeline.emission: Validated little-endian Program -> program.bin, typed static const union views with layout assertions, movement_steps.bin, immutable command tables, generated program.h.
build_pipeline.translation_unit: engine.c includes program.h, command_engine.c and llvm_movement.c; one translation unit sees both runtime and actual circuit.
build_pipeline.compiler: Clang 23.1.4; flags and source hashes recorded under module.
build_pipeline.target: x86_64-pc-windows-msvc; IR target-cpu=x86-64, tune-cpu=generic, SSE2; AMD Ryzen 9 5950X. No march=native, native LTO, PGO or fast-math.
build_pipeline.implicit_flags: clang -### confirms -relaxed-aliasing and -fwrapv. Baseline hot IR has no !tbaa metadata. MSVC target defaults differ from non-Windows Clang.
build_pipeline.identity: Cache hashes Program identity, generator, all four C/header sources, compiler/linker binaries, explicit flags and target OS/architecture. Load checks ABI/semantic version and 32-byte embedded Program identity before initialization.
build_pipeline.verification: Inspected DLL export identity equals its build manifest; semantic version is 38; all emitted C/header source SHA256 hashes equal workspace sources. Frozen copy retained under work/llvm-contracts-20261112/baseline.

optimizer_knowledge.fact: Immutable table addresses, dimensions and useful access types are already visible.
optimizer_knowledge.evidence: current-ir/hot.ll: @ne_static_data external hidden constant align 16; direct GEPs into that object in set_contribution, set_token_pos and apply_movement_flip. Extraction externalizes global initializers; the original bitcode contains the actual embedded constants.
optimizer_knowledge.limit: A runtime-selected record still needs a load. A union containing the whole Program remains one large global; unused fields are not separate discardable linker objects.

optimizer_knowledge.fact: Reactive and lazy-wire selection are circuit constants.
optimizer_knowledge.evidence: ZCore program.h defines NE_STATIC_HAS_REACTIVE=0 and NE_STATIC_LAZY_WIRE_POWER=1; movement IR derives wire power from counts/histogram masks without the generic reactive path.
optimizer_knowledge.limit: No reactive feature does not imply no scheduled ticks, motions or history changes after initialization.

optimizer_knowledge.fact: Most component IDs and table records remain selected by dynamic queues, token positions and groups.
optimizer_knowledge.evidence: apply_movement_flip loads kind through a dynamic component ID and retains a switch including comparator kind 9, although this ZCore Program has no comparators. Source/token selector and occupied-level mask operations are simplified where explicit tests/masks permit it.
optimizer_knowledge.limit: Table validation in ne_create does not communicate a persistent range fact across later exported calls. uint8_t means 0..255, not 0..15. C enum spelling alone would not encode the needed proof.

optimizer_knowledge.fact: Mutable regions are disjoint by construction, but not by their pointer-field types.
optimizer_knowledge.evidence: ne_create partitions one checked allocation into separate counts, histograms, contributions, state and queues. Baseline set_arranged has seven pointer loads and no noalias metadata. GVN reports LoadClobbered after stores.
optimizer_knowledge.limit: A restrict engine pointer does not establish disjointness among loaded pointees. Local restrict variables in the initial probe emitted no alias metadata. Distinct restricted helper parameters did emit scoped !alias.scope/!noalias metadata.

optimizer_knowledge.fact: A batch has exclusive ownership and stable allocations, not constant simulation state.
optimizer_knowledge.evidence: LlvmRuntime::tick_batch takes &mut self; native calls are synchronous; state Vec storage is never resized. Effect growth happens after native return and rebinds before retry. ClockContext is separately owned and cannot reenter the engine.
optimizer_knowledge.limit: Buttons can release from their scheduled tick within a batch. Scheduler state, group indexes, signal levels and effects remain mutable. Two flips may update the same receiver, so disjoint arrays do not make loop iterations independent.

optimizer_knowledge.fact: Clock callback and command presence are still opaque in the generic batch entry.
optimizer_knowledge.evidence: Baseline ne_tick_batch contains 176 duplicated indirect callback sites despite NE_STATIC_COMMAND_COUNT=0. Rust command State::new returns None for an empty command list, but that fact is outside the native translation unit. A feature-gated scratch probe removes all these sites.
optimizer_knowledge.limit: The live Rust clock callback reads separate context, but an ordinary C function-pointer type does not express its memory behavior. Tests include callbacks with observable counter writes. Do not mark the callback pure/readnone or freeze command time across a batch.

optimizer_knowledge.fact: IO publication narrows exported records, not execution semantics.
optimizer_knowledge.evidence: sync_io reads only retained control/output IDs into reusable buffers; no piston/full-snapshot export. Full state is materialized only after timed live execution for verification/reset.
optimizer_knowledge.limit: Unpublished nodes can affect later outputs; reset/off requires full state and pending work. Native read_components receives dynamic IDs and validates them. Specializing this small infrequent export would not eliminate the causal simulation.

remaining_cost: Prior ZCore instruction samples place roughly 59% in token-position replay, movement flips and input accounting, versus about 2.5% output instruction dispatch; this is a prior profile, not a fresh sample of semantic 38.

Current movement IR still loads runtime group values, follows selected flip ranges, obtains component signal values, updates contribution counts and histograms, and delivers ordered callbacks. Those are real dependencies.

Early exits and capacity/operation-limit failures preserve successful prefixes. Vectorizer remarks include calls that cannot be vectorized, control flow that cannot become a select and early-exit loops with complex writes. Removing these checks is not justified by initial table validation.

The default batch implementation duplicates substantial per-tick code without eliminating state across dynamic helper calls. Code-size and register-spill evidence motivates a rolled-loop measurement, not an assumed speedup.

batch-loop-probe.hypothesis: The 176 copies of batch-step code increase instruction-cache and register costs without eliminating hidden state.
batch-loop-probe.correctness_argument: The loop calls the same batch_step once per tick, checks the same status before incrementing completed, and writes the same successful prefix on failure. Counts 0..64 and invalid 65 were compared against scalar execution. No new alias/range assumption.
batch-loop-probe.decision: Rejected after confirmation: the initial +3.23% three-pair median became -0.58% over five new pairs, including three nonpositive pairs. A 57% text reduction did not establish repeatable throughput improvement.

command-absence-probe.hypothesis: The generated zero command count can eliminate callback/capacity branches that the optimizer retains through e->commands.
command-absence-probe.correctness_argument: Normal Rust State::new returns None before binding for an empty immutable command list. The sole Rust bind caller only binds nonempty command state; no concurrency or reentry is permitted. Command-bearing modules retain the original branch.
command-absence-probe.compatibility_limit: The lower-level exported bind function currently accepts an empty command state. Skipping callbacks and missing-clock validation solely from the static count strengthens that lower-level contract. This experiment is not a blanket ABI-preserving change for every manually bound state.
command-absence-probe.decision: Rejected in this form despite +3.41% initial median and +5.11% confirmation ratio of medians: direct empty-binding check proves an exported error/callback behavior change. Confirmation paired gains also vary widely; their median is +1.68%. A future version must preserve the valid empty-binding fallback and be measured independently.

buffer-noalias-probe.hypothesis: Explicit disjoint count/histogram parameters can remove conservative load clobbers and repeated memory accesses.
buffer-noalias-probe.correctness_argument: ne_create lays count arrays and histogram arrays in separate checked, aligned regions. The helper receives only these separate regions and old/new scalar levels, calls no callbacks, and retains the update sequence. All set_arranged callers use the initialized engine.
buffer-noalias-probe.decision: Rejected: +0.23% three-pair median, mixed pairs including -16.51%; no repeatable throughput gain. Emitted noalias metadata is not itself a speedup.

strict-alias-probe.hypothesis: MSVC-target relaxed aliasing suppresses TBAA, allowing stores to clobber unrelated engine pointer-field loads.
strict-alias-probe.correctness_argument: The flag changes optimizer assumptions, not source control flow. ZCore scalar and batch parity passed, but this is insufficient to prove all raw-buffer, union-view, generic diagnostic and Rust FFI accesses satisfy strict aliasing.
strict-alias-probe.decision: Not adopted: +1.99% median over three positive pairs is promising, but a full stronger-contract audit is outstanding. No production compiler flag changed.

ir_evidence.already_optimized: read_u32(link+4) is a single aligned i32 load in IR and movl in assembly. Occupied-level lookup becomes llvm.ctlz of mask|1, not a scan over all histogram levels.
ir_evidence.remarks: current-ir/hot-remarks.yaml includes GVN LoadClobbered and vectorizer early-exit/call/control-flow explanations; duplicated batch copies multiply remark counts, which are not execution frequencies.

retention_decision: No new native runtime optimization or compiler flag retained. Default batch remains 16; strict behavior unchanged. IR simplification alone did not justify a safe repeatable throughput change. All four experiments and their limits are retained as evidence.
